violations.why: ISR overwrites v_onyx with 50 after the task's init to 0, so the loop condition reads 50 instead of 0.
The ISR changes v_onyx between the loop check and its use as the array index, so the index differs from the value that was checked.
The non-atomic v_onyx++ can be interrupted, and the ISR's write of 50 is then overwritten by the stale incremented value.
The ISR overwrites the incremented value before the loop condition reads it, so the condition sees 50.
